_comment: Org-specific tuning for the roster-based assignee suggestion fallback (see main.py: suggest_assignees_from_roster). Edit freely for your org — no code changes needed.
_domain_keywords_comment: Maps words found in a Team Roaster role (skills.md, lowercased) to a domain tag. A person can match more than one domain.
_label_to_domain_comment: Maps a GitHub label name (lowercased) to the domain that owns it. Only labels with an unambiguous domain owner belong here — most labels in a typical repo (marketing/sales/admin/etc.) aren't engineering-domain labels at all and should be left out.
